mapper.select: SELECT department_id, department_code, department_name, is_active FROM department WHERE department_id = #{departmentId}

SELECT d.department_id, d.department_code, d.department_name, d.is_active, COUNT(e.emp_id) AS employee_count
FROM department d
LEFT JOIN emp e ON d.department_id = e.department_id
GROUP BY d.department_id, d.department_code, d.department_name, d.is_active
ORDER BY d.department_id DESC

SELECT d.department_id, d.department_code, d.department_name, d.is_active, COUNT(e.emp_id) AS employee_count FROM department d LEFT JOIN emp e ON d.department_id = e.department_id WHERE d.department_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{departmentName}, '%') OR d.department_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{departmentName}, '%') GROUP BY d.department_id, d.department_code, d.department_name, d.is_active ORDER BY d.department_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE department SET is_active = 0 WHERE department_id = #{departmentId} AND is_active = 1
